learning_outcomes.text: Explain the architecture of a retrieval-backed Claude assistant built on ASP.NET Core and MySQL
Call the Claude API safely from C# with authentication, streaming and error handling
Ground answers in MySQL content by retrieving passages and assembling a cited prompt
Apply cost, caching and safety guardrails to the assistant
Operate the assistant with logging, evaluation and secure configuration

integrative_case: A mid-size firm wants an internal policy assistant: model the policy content in MySQL, build an ASP.NET Core service that retrieves relevant passages and calls Claude for a grounded, cited answer, add a cost ceiling and a no-answer fallback, and log each answer with its sources for review.
